correctness.rationale: For the precise four finite phase alphabets and full 2-by-2-by-3 character support, Parseval yields 45 exact sum-frequency coefficients. A free scalar and three character modulations give q^8 independent normalized cases. The standard-library CHECK.py, executed to completion from the actual package path, enumerated exactly 1,751,969 such arrays with exact Gaussian/Eisenstein norms, establishing the minima 220/210/188/196, next attainable values 228/216/196/200, complete normalized winners 27/48/6/36 and all symmetry orbits. Independently computed difference autocorrelations match on winners and supplementary nonwinners. Finite product grid transfer follows because 45 sum frequencies do not alias for orders at least (3,3,5). No infinite search or continuous-phase assertion is made.

value.rationale: The complete 2-by-2-by-3 prism is the first noncubic three-dimensional full rectangular aperture after the 8-mode cube; for four natural root-of-unity alphabets it has natural exact minimizer, first gap, and symmetry-orbit invariants. The strict comparison 188<196 shows the quaternary alphabet beats the six-phase alphabet, a nontrivial quantization effect absent from prior cube and planar tables. Exact finite-grid transfer yields usable aperiodic-energy conclusions for infinitely many measurement grids. The contribution is a motivated complete finite classification, not a routine re-evaluation of a known table.
